sources.name: Official Hacker News API
sources.comments: HTML comment text, parent ID, child IDs, timestamps, and deleted/dead flags. Reconstruct context by following item links.
sources.history: Historical items by ID and near-real-time updates; no search endpoint.
sources.access: Public Firebase JSON endpoints; documentation states no current rate limit.
sources.limitations: One request per item; deleted text may be absent. Documented score is for stories/poll options, not comment votes. Repository MIT license does not establish a blanket license for comments.
sources.fit: Authoritative validation of discovered comments, parent context and deletion state. Preferred alongside Algolia search.

sources.name: Algolia HN Search
sources.comments: Searchable comment_text with objectID, parent_id, story_id and timestamps; item endpoint returns nested children.
sources.history: Historical index; live probe returned a comment created 2026-11-16T02:42:19Z.
sources.access: Public JSON API. Documentation source states 10,000 requests per hour per IP.
sources.limitations: Global probe reported exhaustiveNbHits=false and 1,000 pages at one hit per page; not a complete export. Source repository was archived in February 2026, while the service remains reachable. No content-reuse license established by API access.
sources.fit: Primary targeted discovery by model/version and date; partition searches, record coverage, and validate against the official API.

sources.name: Nixiesearch HN archive
sources.comments: Raw API items including comment text, parent and kids; despite its name, includes other item types.
sources.access: Public zstd-compressed JSONL files; card declares Apache-2.0.
sources.limitations: No cleaning, validation or filtering; static historical coverage does not support current model sentiment. Declared archive license should not be conflated with underlying contributor rights.
sources.fit: Historical baseline or reproducible offline experiments; filter item types and remove personal fields before retaining results.

sources.name: Nixiesearch HN scraper
sources.comments: Fetches official API item records; parent and child IDs remain available in raw output.
sources.history: Configurable item-ID range with resumable output; this repository is a scraper, not a freshness guarantee for a hosted archive.
sources.access: Open-source Scala scraper; Apache-2.0 code license. Local execution and storage required.
sources.limitations: Broad item sweeps cost requests and storage; output contains fields this app must discard. Code license does not license discussion content.
sources.fit: Reference implementation for resumable collection if a larger historical import is later required.

sources.name: Open-index HN archive
sources.comments: Comment HTML, parent and kids alongside other item types; type is an integer enum.
sources.history: Card describes historical backfill from 2006 and five-minute polling, but displayed update was 2026-08-23 and coverage totals were inconsistent when checked.
sources.access: Public monthly Parquet, live-block files and stats.csv; card declares ODC-BY.
sources.limitations: Do not assume current or complete coverage from the headline. Inspect file inventory, stats and timestamps; mirror updates can lag edits/deletions. Archive terms do not settle underlying content rights.
sources.fit: Promising bulk-analysis option after independently checking its actual date range and update process.

sources.name: Typedef HN 2025 dataset
sources.comments: About 2.5 million comments with text, parent, kids and fetched_at; separate parent-child relationship table.
sources.history: 2025 point-in-time snapshot; exact end date is not specified in the card.
sources.access: Public Parquet downloads. License section describes research and analytical purposes without naming a standard license.
sources.limitations: Some referenced comments are absent; deleted/dead text may be null. Includes personal-profile tables that this app should not ingest. Not a live source.
sources.fit: Small-scope historical threading and sentiment experiments using only comment and story tables.

sources.name: ClickHouse HN sample dataset
sources.comments: Schema contains text, type, parent, kids, deleted and dead, allowing comment filtering and thread reconstruction.
sources.history: Documentation describes a 28-million-row sample; no current end date or refresh promise is stated there.
sources.access: Public CSV and Parquet examples; compressed CSV is documented as 4.6 GB. Local query/storage costs apply.
sources.limitations: Sample dataset is not evidence of current coverage. No dataset-specific content license established by the inspected page.
sources.fit: Bulk SQL prototyping; check temporal coverage before using for model-version comparisons.

sources.name: Google BigQuery public HN dataset
sources.comments: Google examples query HN text from bigquery-public-data.hacker_news.full. Inspect current schema and parent availability before integrating.
sources.history: Historical table; present freshness and full comment coverage were not queried in this review.
sources.access: Google Cloud project required. Public-dataset storage is covered; queries consume the free allowance or incur query charges.
sources.limitations: No public-dataset SLA. Marketplace update date is not data freshness. No dataset-specific content license verified here; no paid query was run.
sources.fit: Optional large historical analysis when an existing BigQuery project and explicit query budget are available.
